# YVPlayer — Complete Technical Specification & API Reference

> Cinema-grade, distraction-free HTML5-style YouTube player with zero branding, custom storyboard timeline scrub previews, 720p HD Picture-in-Picture, custom themes, line-by-line captions, and rich keyboard gestures.

## Core Architecture Overview
YVPlayer wraps the Google YouTube IFrame API (`https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api`) inside a custom UI layer. The underlying YouTube iframe is placed inside an isolated container while YVPlayer renders full custom HTML5-like media controls on top of it. All YouTube default annotations, branding cards, video titles, and end-screen suggestions are masked or suppressed.

### Zero Dependencies
YVPlayer requires no external JavaScript frameworks. It ships as a single lightweight core JS file (`yvPlayer.js`), a companion CSS file (`yvPlayer.css`), and Tabler Icons webfont for vector iconography.

## JavaScript API Reference

### Global Object
The library exposes the global object `window.YVPlayer`.

### Initialization: `YVPlayer.init(containerId, options)`
Initializes a new player instance inside the DOM element identified by `containerId`.

#### Configuration Options
- `defaultId` (string, required): 11-character YouTube video ID or full YouTube URL.
- `autoplay` (boolean, default: `false`): Whether to start playback automatically on mount.
- `thumbnail` (boolean, default: `true`): Whether to preload the video poster thumbnail.
- `isLive` (boolean, default: `false`): Enables live stream broadcast controls (removes seekbar slider, displays real-time `LIVE` sync dot).
- `shorts` (boolean, default: `false`): Enables 9:16 vertical video layout mode.
- `background` (boolean, default: `false`): Ambient mode (muted, looping, zero player chrome/controls, runs seamlessly behind web content).
- `theme` (string, default: `null`): CSS accent theme name (`"red"`, `"cyan"`, `"purple"`, `"emerald"`, `"amber"`, `"white"`, `"monochrome"`).
- `controls` (boolean, default: `true`): Whether player controls should be displayed.
- `loop` (boolean, default: `false`): Loop playback automatically when video finishes.
- `pipMode` (string, default: `"dual"`): Picture-in-picture engine strategy (`"dual"`, `"document"`, `"os"`, or `"inpage"`).

### Methods
- `YVPlayer.play(containerId)`: Starts or resumes video playback.
- `YVPlayer.pause(containerId)`: Pauses video playback.
- `YVPlayer.togglePlay(containerId)`: Toggles play/pause state.
- `YVPlayer.mute(containerId)`: Mutes video audio.
- `YVPlayer.unMute(containerId)`: Unmutes video audio.
- `YVPlayer.toggleMute(containerId)`: Toggles mute status.
- `YVPlayer.setVolume(containerId, volume)`: Sets volume level between `0` and `100`.
- `YVPlayer.seekTo(containerId, seconds)`: Seeks to specific time offset in seconds.
- `YVPlayer.seekBy(containerId, deltaSeconds)`: Relative seek (e.g., `+10` or `-10`).
- `YVPlayer.setSpeed(containerId, rate)`: Sets playback rate (`0.25`, `0.5`, `0.75`, `1.0`, `1.25`, `1.5`, `1.75`, `2.0`).
- `YVPlayer.changeVideo(containerId, videoId, options)`: Dynamically swaps the active video stream without reloading the container DOM.
- `YVPlayer.togglePiP(containerId)`: Activates or exits Picture-in-Picture window.
- `YVPlayer.toggleFullscreen(containerId)`: Toggles full-screen view.
- `YVPlayer.destroy(containerId)`: Disposes the YouTube player instance and cleans up event listeners.

## Keyboard Hotkey Map
- `Space` or `K`: Toggle play/pause
- `J`: Seek backward 10 seconds
- `L`: Seek forward 10 seconds
- `ArrowLeft`: Seek backward 5 seconds
- `ArrowRight`: Seek forward 5 seconds
- `ArrowUp`: Increase volume by 5%
- `ArrowDown`: Decrease volume by 5%
- `M`: Toggle audio mute
- `F`: Toggle fullscreen
- `P`: Toggle Picture-in-Picture mode
- `C`: Toggle closed captions
- `0`-`9`: Jump to percentage of video duration (e.g. `5` jumps to 50%)
- `?`: Open keyboard shortcuts cheat sheet dialog

## Dual-Engine Picture-in-Picture Architecture
1. **Document Picture-in-Picture API**: For Chromium browsers supporting the new Window-level PiP standard, YVPlayer opens a native OS floating window containing the full interactive player with volume controls, captions, seekbar, and speed controls.
2. **Native Video PiP Stream**: When Document PiP is unavailable, YVPlayer utilizes open-source proxy stream resolution (via Piped / Invidious API) to fetch direct 720p video tracks into a hidden `<video>` element and activates standard OS `video.requestPictureInPicture()`.
3. **In-Page Floating Dock**: If neither native API is supported, an in-page sticky floating viewport with 4-corner 16:9 resize handles docks to the corner of the browser window as the user scrolls.

## Declarative 1-Click Drop-In HTML
```html
<link rel="preload" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/thevikasgurjar/YVplayer@main/fonts/tabler-icons.woff2" as="font" type="font/woff2" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/thevikasgurjar/YVplayer@main/tabler-icons.min.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/thevikasgurjar/YVplayer@main/yvPlayer.css">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/thevikasgurjar/YVplayer@main/yvPlayer.js" defer></script>

<div
  data-yv-video="M7lc1UVf-VE"
  data-yv-theme="red"
  style="width: 100%; max-width: 960px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; margin: 0 auto; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden;"
></div>
```
